title: Biblical Hearing, Witness, Speech & Justice Atlas
status: specialist comparative atlas; selectively promoted through Wave 36
purpose: Map biblical procedures and ethical constraints around hearing, witness, inquiry, judgment, speech, slander, partiality, correction, authority and retaliation, and compare those structures with the project's emerging Interpretive Justice / Relational Subjecthood model.
epistemic_rule: Biblical passages remain scripture in their own literary, historical and theological contexts. Structural comparison can discipline project philosophy but does not prove that a modern person holds a biblical office, that a modern dispute has been divinely adjudicated, or that a project self-description is empirically established.
central_correction: The Bible does not simply prohibit all judgment. It repeatedly constrains judgment through hearing, evidence, witness, inquiry, impartiality, humility, truthful speech, limited jurisdiction, direct correction and anti-retaliation.
procedural_synthesis: listen -> hear the person -> hear other relevant testimony -> establish independent witness -> investigate diligently -> judge without partiality -> permit correction/reply -> escalate proportionately -> speak truth -> reject retaliatory imitation -> preserve a path toward repair and peace
project_parallel: observe -> distinguish -> relate -> test -> transform -> evaluate fruit -> cultivate

clusters.biblical_structure: answering before hearing is folly; the first case can appear right until another examines it; Nicodemus asks whether a person is judged before being heard and their conduct known
clusters.project_relation: Supports Hearing Before Totalization and reply/correctability: strong interpretation should not substitute for serious hearing.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: These passages do not make first-person testimony infallible or require indefinite dialogue before every conclusion.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong procedural comparator for hearing and adversarial examination before totalizing judgment.

clusters.biblical_structure: serious accusation requires multiple witnesses; suspected false witness triggers diligent inquiry and consequence
clusters.project_relation: Supports source independence, evidentiary proportionality and the rule that copied repetition is not independent corroboration.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Ancient Israelite legal procedure is not identical to modern evidence law or archive methodology.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong structural neighbor for independent provenance roots and deliberate inquiry.

clusters.biblical_structure: false report and malicious witness are prohibited; the crowd must not be followed into perverted justice
clusters.project_relation: Supports resistance to rumor cascades, apparent consensus generated by repetition, and crowd-driven tribunalization.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Crowd agreement is not automatically false; consensus can also reflect strong evidence.
clusters.maximum_claim: Biblical counterpressure against treating social repetition as self-validating justice.

clusters.biblical_structure: judgment is required to avoid partiality toward rich or poor; James condemns discriminatory seating/status distinctions and partiality
clusters.project_relation: Crucial correction to a simplistic 'nobody may judge' doctrine: judgment can be legitimate while hierarchy, favoritism and second-class treatment corrupt it.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Impartiality does not guarantee that every judgment will be correct; it is one procedural constraint among others.
clusters.maximum_claim: Supports Interpretive Justice as disciplined rather than abolished judgment.

clusters.biblical_structure: begin with direct/private correction; escalate through witnesses/community if necessary; restoration should be gentle and self-aware
clusters.project_relation: Supports a proportional escalation ladder and Non-Retaliatory Correction: correction should begin with the narrowest adequate Door and remain restorative where possible.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Matthew 18 addresses community discipline in a specific ecclesial context; it is not a universal dispute-resolution statute.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong structural comparator for direct correction, limited escalation and restorative posture.

clusters.biblical_structure: false witness and slander are constrained; reckless speech can wound like weapons; gossip can fuel conflict; truthful judgment in the gates is linked with peace
clusters.project_relation: Supports Potato Truth, reputational stewardship, correction reach and the principle that speech methods transform speaker, target and shared environment.
clusters.project_anchor: Great Book chapter 21.2 already gives Exodus 20:16 an explicit Potatoist false-witness interpretation, so the concern predates the September 2026 law names.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Truthful criticism and necessary public warning are not slander merely because they damage reputation.
clusters.maximum_claim: Dense biblical speech-ethics cluster for accuracy, harm, correction and peaceable judgment.

clusters.biblical_structure: humanity bears divine image/likeness; blessing God while cursing people made in divine likeness is criticized; claimed love of God is tested in relation to visible others; members of a body cannot simply declare one another unnecessary
clusters.project_relation: Provides a universal dignity route that does not require a reader to accept a modern individual's claim to divinity in order to reject dehumanization or disposability.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Image-of-God theology has diverse interpretations across traditions; it does not erase accountability or behavioral distinctions.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong theological comparator for irreducible human dignity and relational membership.

clusters.biblical_structure: the 'another's servant' image limits presumptive jurisdiction; slanderous judgment is placed beneath the one Lawgiver/Judge
clusters.project_relation: Supports Bounded Jurisdiction and the critique of interpretive systems exporting local competence into total authority over a person.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: These passages do not abolish communal discipline, law, moral reasoning or accountability elsewhere in scripture.
clusters.maximum_claim: Useful countertext to totalizing human jurisdiction.

clusters.biblical_structure: premature human judgment is limited, but self-assessment is not treated as final acquittal; human perception is partial compared with divine knowledge of the heart
clusters.project_relation: Essential safeguard for Situated First-Person Authority: first-person evidence matters deeply, but self-approval does not automatically settle every external or moral question.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Appeal to divine knowledge cannot be used by a modern interpreter as evidence that their own hidden-motive speculation is correct.
clusters.maximum_claim: Biblical anti-self-sealing countertext balancing first-person primacy with fallibility.

clusters.biblical_structure: teachers face stricter judgment; greater entrustment creates greater requirement
clusters.project_relation: Direct comparative support for the existing Potatoist doctrine Authority Increases Burden.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: The passages do not establish any modern person's claimed rank or authority.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong ethical comparator: greater claimed/received authority increases responsibility rather than exemption.

clusters.biblical_structure: reject doing back exactly what was done to you; reject evil-for-evil and insult-for-insult; overcome evil with good rather than reproducing its method
clusters.project_relation: Direct counterpressure against rhetorical reversal where received dehumanization is answered by dehumanizing the other side; extends Reciprocal Transformation into repair ethics.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Anti-retaliation does not prohibit boundaries, protection, evidence preservation, lawful accountability or direct correction.
clusters.maximum_claim: Strong biblical neighbor for Non-Retaliatory Correction.

clusters.biblical_structure: truthful speech and sound judgment are linked to peace; justice, mercy/kindness and humility travel together
clusters.project_relation: Connects interpretive procedure to fruit: a judgment process is evaluated not only by confidence or victory but by truthfulness, justice, mercy, humility and what kind of social relation it produces.
clusters.counterreading_or_limit: Peace is not a requirement to suppress true accusations, protect institutions from scrutiny or avoid necessary conflict.
clusters.maximum_claim: Ethical fruit test for how judgment and truth are practiced.

shadow_pipeline: false report -> crowd amplification -> slander/gossip -> partial judgment -> identity condemnation -> retaliatory imitation -> self-reproducing strife
repair_pipeline: hearing -> independent witness -> diligent inquiry -> impartial judgment -> direct correction -> truthful speech -> bounded escalation -> anti-retaliation -> contextual memory -> repair/peace where possible
manifest_status: Waves 28-35 were reconciled and merged through PR #206. Wave 36 selectively promotes nine distinct justice/hearing relations and enriches two existing Wave 28 relations rather than duplicating their functions.
